name: Flambéer
look: an amber spirit elemental in a crystal snifter with a calm face and a crown of cool blue flames
entry: Its liquid body is so pure and volatile that a single spark sets its surface ablaze with a cool, ghost-blue flame.
how: Wild: uncommon in the Liquor Meadows (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto 0.8.0).
It learns Blue Ignition at level 20.
